authored_narrative.episode_purpose: Every motif this Story has tracked converges here — threshold, duty, recognition, return, stillness, shared labor — not as a checklist, but as the accumulated posture of two people who no longer need any of it explained to them.

scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.purpose: A space that once demanded vigilance now asks nothing of Gonagi at all — the clearest sign yet that the growth this Story has tracked was never really about the spaces, but about what Gonagi brought to them.
scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.stakes: whether a Story can end on stillness without that stillness reading as anticlimax
scene_spirited_away_parental_transformat.opposing_force: the temptation to manufacture one more crisis, when the honest truth is that the crises have already done their work

scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0036.purpose: The bridge-crossing anchor's shape appears once more, folded into a memory of a train rather than the crossing itself — the motif has become internal, no longer needing an actual bridge to mean something.
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0036.stakes: whether the relationship this Story tracked needs a final test, or whether it has already passed every test it was going to face
scene_spirited_away_train_memory_0036.opposing_force: nothing external — the last real obstacle in this Story was already cleared several episodes ago

shot_spirited_00273.intent: A completely still frame, longer than any other in this Story — the first time stillness itself is trusted to be the entire content of a shot.

shot_spirited_00281.intent: A soft-focus echo of every prior establishing shot in this Story at once, deliberately unspecific — closing the visual language rather than adding to it.
